verdicts.why: Mack hugs Bobbi and they laugh as old friends when she arrives at the Playground in S2E5 (A Hen in the Wolf House). The undercover mission and Iliad backstory come out in S2E13 to S2E15, so they stay at S2#15.
Gonzales first appears in S2E14, greeting Mack warmly when Mack brings Hunter aboard, and the infiltration of Coulson's team for him is explained there. The Iliad flashback is S2E15.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
value.text: Mack and Lance Hunter become friends on Coulson's team, trading bets, drinks and stories.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mack trades bets and stories with.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Hunter trades bets and stories with.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#13
split.text: Lance Hunter becomes close friends with Mack and Bobbi Morse on a mission in Dubai. When Hunter later catches the two of them keeping secrets, Mack brings him aboard Robert Gonzales' carrier to explain.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend, who catches Mack and Bobbi keeping secrets.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend, who brings Hunter aboard Gonzales' carrier to explain.

verdicts.why: Mack wins a bet with Hunter in S2E3, but the drinks and stories are S2E4, so the stage as written is only fully true from S2#4. The split is right: the Dubai backstory and Mack taking Hunter to the Iliad are S2E13, after the S2E12 secrets confrontation.
Mack and Fitz first work together in S2E2 (Heavy Is the Head), modifying the Overkill Device, which forms their friendship. Mack shields Fitz from Bobbi's bomb in S2E15.
Mack knocks out Lincoln aboard the Iliad when he finds him with Skye in S.O.S. Part Two (S2E22). They have no earlier scene together.

In S3E7 (Chaos Theory) Lincoln calls Mack, they take the Lash theory to Coulson together, and Lincoln accepts Coulson's offer to stay. Before that, in S3E1 to S3E3, they are at odds. Mack as acting Director greenlights the Caterpillars and brings Lincoln on the Hydra mission in S3E9.
Mack guards the Terrigen crystals and fights Gordon in S.O.S. Part Two (S2E22). In S2E21 Gordon only notes that Mack is still loose on the ship.
Simmons first talks with Mack in S2E6 (A Fractured House), thanking him for helping Fitz. They have no direct scene in S2E5.
Daisy, Hunter and Mack reach Joey in Seattle ahead of the ATCU in S3E1 (Laws of Nature). Mack, as acting Director, greenlights Joey's first Secret Warriors mission in S3E9.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#5
value.text: Mack and Robbie Reyes break Eli Morrow out of prison during a riot, so S.H.I.E.L.D. can use him against the ghosts.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A prisoner Mack breaks out to help against the ghosts.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who breaks Eli out of prison.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#7
split.text: Eli turns out to be the real threat, and Mack, briefly becoming Ghost Rider himself, hunts Eli and then agrees to help bring him down.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A prisoner Mack breaks out, who proves to be the real threat.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who breaks Eli out, then hunts him as Ghost Rider.

verdicts.why: In S4E4 only Coulson goes in to see Morrow while Mack waits outside and spots Reyes. Mack first deals with Eli in S4E5, breaking him out with Reyes. Mack is possessed by the Spirit, hunts Eli and agrees to help take him down in S4E7, so the enemy split goes there instead of S4#6.

Ghost Rider saves Mack and Fitz from the ghost Frederick at Momentum in S4E2, after Mack and Coulson's S4E1 hunt for Quake. The Spirit possesses Mack, and Robbie confronts him at the Chinatown Crew warehouse, in S4E7.

Mack's distrust of Aida comes in S4E9 (Broken Promises), where he warns Fitz and Radcliffe that Aida could rebel and then blames Radcliffe for her. Nothing between them in S4E1 supports a bare S4 start.
Mack declares the revolution against Kasius' rule in S5E8 (The Last Day), faces Kasius in S5E9, and kills him in S5E10.
In S5E6 (Fun & Games) Mack, Coulson and Tess hide the newly powered Flint from the Kree. Mack comforts Flint after Tess's death and stays behind with Yo-Yo in S5E7.
Mack's forgiveness of Creel is only shown in S5E21 (The Force of Gravity), when he tells Yo-Yo about it after seeing Talbot kill Creel.
Daisy chooses Mack to lead S.H.I.E.L.D. in the season 5 finale, S5E22 (The End).
Daisy steps aside and chooses Mack as Director in S5E22 (The End).

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#4
value.text: Mack, now Director, rescues Deke from Sarge's squad.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mack rescues from Sarge.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Deke's friend and Director, who rescues him from Sarge.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
split.text: Once Deke proves himself by saving his friends from Izel, Mack makes him an official S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mack makes an official agent.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Deke's friend and Director, who makes him an official agent.

verdicts.why: Deke first appears in season 6 in S6E4 (Code Yellow), where Mack's strike team takes on Sarge's crew. But Mack makes him an official agent only in S6E12, so that fact is split out instead of shown from S6#4.

Garner first appears in S2E13. Coulson's secret consultations with him come out in S2E17 (Melinda), when May goes through Coulson's actions. Coulson says the sessions were about his alien writing in S2E19.

In S3E7 (Chaos Theory) Garner, as Lash, holds May captive, and she talks him down, shoots him into the Containment Module and has him sent off in stasis. Her question about whether everything bad came from their meeting is S3E15 (Spacetime).
Garner is assigned to assess Simmons in S3E3, and their session is S3E4 (Devils You Know). She opens his containment module at Hydra's castle in S3E10.
Garner evaluates Joey and finds him unfit, melting the doorknob included, in S3E2 (Purpose in the Machine). He reassesses Joey when May bursts in in S3E7.
In S3E8 (Many Heads, One Tale) Garner has been moved out of Endotex, Malick visits him, and Ward gasses him into Lash. They have no contact before that.
Werner, as 'Alexander Braun', joins Garner's Psych 101 class in S3E2. He corners Garner at the end of S3E4, and Garner's transformation and the slaughter are shown in S3E6.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
value.text: Anne Weaver sits on Robert Gonzales' council, which sees Skye's new powers as a threat and sends agents to bring her in.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A gifted agent Weaver's council sends people to bring in.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A council member wary of Daisy's powers.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22
split.text: Weaver wants the Inhumans treated as a threat, but when Jiaying's Inhumans seize the Iliad, Skye and Coulson's team retake the ship and save her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman Weaver's council debated capturing, who later saves her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A council member wary of Daisy's powers, whom Daisy later helps save.

verdicts.why: Weaver first appears in S2E14, and her council plans to bring Skye in, sending Calderon and Morse, in S2E15, so S2#15 is right. But the Iliad rescue is S2E22 and her push to treat the Inhumans as a threat is S2E20 to S2E21, so those move to a split, and the S2#15 piece is a rival stage.
Weaver helps Simmons and Mack secure the alien artifacts, the Monolith included, after the Inhuman crisis in S2E22.

Weaver and Oliver vote against Coulson's mission to rescue the enhanced prisoners in S2E19 (The Dirty Half Dozen). She urges a strong show of force against the Inhumans, which Coulson refuses, in S2E21.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#16
value.text: Antoine Triplett fights Deathlok while Mike Peterson is under the Clairvoyant's control, shocking him with tasers when Deathlok attacks him and John Garrett.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Under the Clairvoyant's control when Trip tasers him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who fights Mike while the Clairvoyant controls him.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
split.text: Mike finally turns on John Garrett, the man who controlled him all along.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Under the Clairvoyant's control when Trip tasers him, until he turns on Garrett.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who fights Mike while the Clairvoyant controls him.

verdicts.why: Deathlok attacks Garrett and Triplett at the Sydney safe house in S1E16, so S1#16 is right. But Garrett is revealed as the Clairvoyant in S1E17, and Mike turns on him in S1E22, so that sentence is split out.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#18
value.text: Trip joins Phil Coulson's team after his own mentor John Garrett is exposed as Hydra.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A friend whose team Trip joins after Garrett's betrayal.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A loyal agent who joins Coulson's team after Garrett is exposed.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
split.text: Trip fights beside Coulson, even stealing an armored vehicle with him to break into Cybertek.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Trip fights beside, even stealing an armored truck together.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A loyal agent who fights beside Coulson at Cybertek.

verdicts.why: Trip asks to join and Coulson takes him on in S1E18 (Providence), so S1#18 is right. But the Humvee break-in at Cybertek is S1E22 (Beginning of the End), four episodes later, so it is split out.
Triplett and Simmons stay behind at the Hub with Hand in S1E16 (End of the Beginning). Her fake Hydra loyalty test is S1E17.
Billy is only mentioned before the season 1 finale. He first appears in S1E22, greeting the team at the Playground, where Skye mistakes him for Eric.
Billy is only mentioned by Eric in S1E18 and S1E19. He first appears, already mourning Eric and running the Playground, in S1E22.
Fury rescues Fitz and Simmons from the sea and brings the team to Billy's Playground in S1E22.
Fury makes Coulson Director, and Billy hands him the Playground, in S1E22.
Bobbi brings Skye supplies in quarantine in S2E11 (Aftershocks), after Trip's death. She volunteers to bring Skye in for Gonzales in S2E15.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#6
value.text: Bobbi Morse works with General Glenn Talbot as S.H.I.E.L.D. hunts down Hydra, helping hand captured Hydra agents over to his custody.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The general Bobbi hands Hydra prisoners over to.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who hands Talbot Hydra prisoners.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
split.text: Bobbi and Lance Hunter capture Hydra's Sunil Bakshi so he can be handed over to Talbot.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The general Bobbi hands Hydra prisoners over to, including Bakshi.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who hands Talbot Hydra prisoners, including Bakshi.

verdicts.why: Bobbi is on May's S2E6 team that catches the Hydra agents behind the UN attack and turns them over to Talbot, so S2#6 is right. But the Bakshi handover named in the text is S2E11, so it is split out.

Bobbi and Ward first clash in S2E7 (The Writing on the Wall), when he spots her on the bus and threatens to set off his C4. The Kara kidnapping starts in S2E20 (Scars). Note: the torture (S2E21) and Hunter's rescue (S2E22) are one and two episodes after the S2#20 split.
Bobbi, Hydra's head of security, breaks cover to rescue Simmons and bring her home in S2E5 (A Hen in the Wolf House).
Bobbi greets Joey in his containment module and tells him he is safe in S3E1 (Laws of Nature). She cheers his door-sealing idea in S3E10 (Maveth).

Their meeting in S2E19 is friendly. The enmity starts in S2E20 (Scars), when Kara, disguised as May, captures Bobbi for Ward and throws Bobbi's betrayal in her face. Note: the torture the text calls 'later' is S2E21.
